trans-unit.source:
Rules are checked from top to bottom, stopping after the first match. They can match:
- By address: `192.168.0.1` - By network: `192.168.0.0/24` - By network scope: `Localhost`, `LAN` or `Internet` - By domain: - Matching a distinct domain: `example.com` - Matching a domain with subdomains: `.example.com` - Matching with a wildcard prefix: `*xample.com` - Matching with a wildcard suffix: `example.*` - Matching domains containing text: `*example*` - By country (based on IP): `US` ([two-letter country codes according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)) - By continent (based on IP): `C:US` (prefix `AF`, `AN`, `AS`, `EU`, `NA`, `OC`, or `SA` with `C:`) - By AS number: `AS123456` - By filter list - use the filterlist ID prefixed with `L:`: `L:MAL` - Match anything: `*`
Additionally, you may supply a protocol and port using this format: `<host> <IP protocol>/<port>`.
Protocols and ports may be specified using numbers (`6/80`) or names (`TCP/HTTP`). Port ranges are defined by using a hyphen (`TCP/1-1024`). Omit the port to match any. Use a `*` for matching any protocol. If matching ports with any protocol, protocols without ports will not match. Rules with protocol and port definitions only match if the protocol and port also match. Ports are always compared to the destination port, thus, the local listening port for incoming connections.
Examples: - `192.168.0.1 TCP/HTTP` - `LAN UDP/50000-55000` - `example.com */HTTPS` - `1.1.1.1 ICMP`
Important: DNS Requests are only matched against domain and filter list rules, all others require an IP address and are checked only with the following IP connection.
Pro Tip: You can use `#` to add a comment to a rule.
trans-unit.target:
规则按从上到下的顺序检查，首次匹配后即停止。可按以下条件匹配：
- 地址：`192.168.0.1` - 网段：`192.168.0.0/24` - 网络范围：`Localhost`、`LAN` 或 `Internet` - 域名： - 匹配指定域名：`example.com` - 匹配域名及其子域名：`.example.com` - 使用前缀通配符匹配：`*xample.com` - 使用后缀通配符匹配：`example.*` - 匹配包含指定文本的域名：`*example*` - 国家或地区（基于 IP）：`US`（[ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 两字母国家代码](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)） - 大洲（基于 IP）：`C:US`（在 `AF`、`AN`、`AS`、`EU`、`NA`、`OC` 或 `SA` 前添加 `C:`） - 自治系统编号：`AS123456` - 过滤列表：使用带有 `L:` 前缀的过滤列表 ID，例如 `L:MAL` - 匹配任意目标：`*`
此外，可以按以下格式指定协议和端口：`<host> <IP protocol>/<port>`。
协议和端口可使用数字（`6/80`）或名称（`TCP/HTTP`）指定。 使用连字符指定端口范围（`TCP/1-1024`）。省略端口则匹配任意端口。 使用 `*` 匹配任意协议。若指定端口并匹配任意协议，则不带端口的协议不会匹配。 指定了协议和端口的规则，只有协议和端口也匹配时才会生效。 端口始终与目标端口比较；对于入站连接，即本地监听端口。
示例： - `192.168.0.1 TCP/HTTP` - `LAN UDP/50000-55000` - `example.com */HTTPS` - `1.1.1.1 ICMP`
重要提示：DNS 请求仅与域名和过滤列表规则匹配。其他规则都需要 IP 地址，仅在后续的 IP 连接中检查。
使用技巧：可以用 `#` 为规则添加注释。

trans-unit.source:
DNS servers are used in the order as entered. The first one will be used as the primary DNS Server. Only if it fails, will the other servers be used as a fallback - in their respective order. If all fail, or if no DNS Server is configured here, the Portmaster will use the one configured in your system or network.
Additionally, if it is more likely that the DNS server of your system or network has a (better) answer to a request, they will be asked first. This will be the case for special local domains and domain spaces announced on the current network.
DNS servers are configured in a URL format. This allows you to specify special settings for a resolver. If you just want to use a resolver at IP 10.2.3.4, please enter: `dns://10.2.3.4` The format is: `protocol://host:port?parameter=value&parameter=value`
For DoH servers, you can also just paste the URL given by the DNS provider. When referring to the DNS server using a domain name, as with DoH, it is highly recommended to also specify the IP address using the `ip` parameter, so Portmaster does not have to resolve it.
- Protocol - `dot`: DNS-over-TLS (or `tls`; recommended) - `doh`: DNS-over-HTTPS (or `https`) - `dns`: plain old DNS - `tcp`: plain old DNS over TCP - Host: specify the domain or IP of the resolver - Port: optionally define a custom port - Parameters: - `name`: give your DNS Server a name that is used for messages and logs - `verify`: domain name to verify for `dot`, only valid for `dot` and `doh` - `ip`: IP address (if using a domain), so Portmaster does not need to resolve it using the system resolver - this is highly recommended - `blockedif`: detect if the name server blocks a query, options: - `empty`: server replies with NXDomain status, but without any other record in any section - `refused`: server replies with Refused status - `zeroip`: server replies with an IP address, but it is zero - `search`: specify prioritized domains/TLDs for this resolver (delimited by `,`) - `search-only`: use this resolver for domains in the `search` parameter only (no value)
trans-unit.target:
DNS 服务器按输入顺序使用。第一个服务器作为主 DNS 服务器；只有它发生故障时，才会按顺序使用后续服务器作为备用。如果所有服务器均失败，或此处未配置 DNS 服务器，Portmaster 将使用系统或网络配置的服务器。
此外，如果系统或网络的 DNS 服务器更有可能提供正确或更合适的答案，Portmaster 会优先查询它们，例如解析特殊的本地域名以及当前网络公布的域名范围时。
DNS 服务器采用 URL 格式配置，以便为解析器指定特殊设置。如果只想使用 IP 地址为 10.2.3.4 的解析器，请输入：`dns://10.2.3.4` 格式为：`protocol://host:port?parameter=value&parameter=value`
对于 DoH 服务器，也可以直接粘贴 DNS 服务商提供的 URL。 通过域名指定 DNS 服务器（例如 DoH）时，强烈建议同时使用 `ip` 参数指定 IP 地址，避免 Portmaster 需要先解析该域名。
- 协议 - `dot`：DNS-over-TLS（也可使用 `tls`，推荐） - `doh`：DNS-over-HTTPS（也可使用 `https`） - `dns`：传统的明文 DNS - `tcp`：基于 TCP 的传统明文 DNS - 主机：指定解析器的域名或 IP 地址 - 端口：可选，用于指定自定义端口 - 参数： - `name`：为 DNS 服务器命名，该名称用于消息和日志 - `verify`：为 `dot` 指定待验证的域名，仅适用于 `dot` 和 `doh` - `ip`：使用域名时指定 IP 地址，避免 Portmaster 通过系统解析器解析该域名，强烈建议设置 - `blockedif`：检测 DNS 服务器是否阻止了查询，可选值： - `empty`：服务器返回 NXDomain 状态，且响应的所有区段中均不含其他记录 - `refused`：服务器返回 Refused 状态 - `zeroip`：服务器返回一个值为零的 IP 地址 - `search`：指定此解析器优先处理的域名或顶级域名（以 `,` 分隔） - `search-only`：仅将此解析器用于 `search` 参数中的域名（无需设置参数值）
